name: JRC Photovoltaic Geographical Information System (PVGIS) API
gives: hourly solar radiation and PV output estimates for any point in Europe, including Portugal

why.basis: robots.txt disallows everything on re.jrc.ec.europa.eu. The JRC documentation page gives a rate limit of 30 calls per second per IP address and bars browser (AJAX) calls, but the host's robots rule governs and is respected here

interface: GET https://re.jrc.ec.europa.eu/api/v5_3/seriescalc?lat=..&lon=..&outputformat=json (no key). Not to be used by this service while robots.txt disallows it.
notes: Refused by robots.txt: recorded as a gap, never worked around. Disclosure: one single probe request to the API was sent in the same step as the robots.txt fetch, before the disallow was read; it returned data and nothing was kept. Ask the JRC (PVGIS support page) if an automated read is allowed, a person to send.
